article.title: YouArt推出桌面影片代理，把客戶意見連到指定鏡頭
article.summary: YouArt公布Mac及PC桌面工具，可讀取本機專案資料，並把客戶意見放到相關畫面。
highlights: 創作人可審閱修訂並決定保留哪些版本。
經使用者授權，代理可操作After Effects及Premiere等指定工具。
article.why: 製作團隊可減少在回饋訊息和專案時間軸之間來回查找，並保留審稿責任。
article.next_step: 用複製專案測試一項客戶修訂，記錄檔案權限、改動位置及回復版本所需的步驟。
article.detail: YouArt表示，桌面代理可把Slack或Gmail來的意見連到相關鏡頭、畫格或創意元素。獲使用者授權後，可在指定剪輯工具中執行部分操作，創作人仍可檢查並決定保留哪些修改。團隊試用時可先選擇容易回復的修改，並把原始專案、修訂檔和審稿紀錄分開保存。
article.title_en: YouArt launches desktop video agent that attaches feedback to shots
article.summary_en: YouArt announced a Mac and PC tool that can work with local project files and attach client feedback to relevant shots.
highlights_en: Creators review revisions and decide which changes to keep.
With permission, the agent can operate supported applications such as After Effects and Premiere Pro.
article.why_en: Production teams can link feedback to timelines while keeping creative reviews with people.
article.next_step_en: Test one revision on a copy, tracking file permissions, edits and how to restore the previous version.
article.detail_en: YouArt says its desktop agent can attach feedback from Slack or Gmail to a shot, frame or creative element. With user permission it can perform tasks in supported editing applications. Creators review and choose what to keep. Start with a reversible change and keep the original project, revised file and approval record separately.
